product_under_test.availability_caveat: This path is a scratch directory. It is not tracked, not backed up, and has been lost at a session boundary before. episode.py verifies this digest before every episode so a missing or different build stops the run instead of silently changing what was measured.

why_the_checked_out_dist_is_informationa: The tree has moved past v1.2.0, so dist/commitlore.mjs is expected to differ from the pin. It is recorded because a reader who sees only a digest will assume it is the one that ran.
why_this_is_carried_forward_rather_than_: v8 measures the same shipping build v7 pinned. Remeasuring would let the pinned identity follow whatever happens to be checked out, which is the drift the lock exists to catch.
